observations.text: Fasting plasma glucose was 152 mg/dL on the 2026-07-11 lab report (reference 70-100), flagged high. It was 171 mg/dL on the 2026-04-12 report. HbA1c was 7.6% on the latest report and 8.4% on the earlier one, both above the 4.0-5.6% reference range.
Logged blood glucose readings show a rising trend, with the latest at 128, up about 23% from the earlier baseline.

Missed or skipped lunch was noted in entries on 2026-07-31 and 2026-08-30. On 2026-07-31, shakiness, sweating, dizziness and a racing heart around 3pm were logged, followed by a biscuit. Shakiness is currently logged as 2 stable episodes.
